I saved Pree's new cutoff date for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork (21 October from now on) in gbrain as a private note under her name, and replied to her in our DM to confirm.

My first save was marked visible to everyone in the brain, even though I'd asked for it not to be shared. I deleted it about 10 seconds later and saved it again as private, which worked. While it was live, only her name and that date were visible, and nobody was asked about it.

She said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else.
